title: Avro Lancaster LM311
memorial_details: A metal plaque attached to a backboard, mounted on a rough hewn stone on a concrete base. Lettering is incised and picked out in black. The plaque refers to a memorial tree, probably a Eucalyptus planted in 1995. By 2015 an immature sapling was recorded, presumably having replaced the original tree. By December 2020 the sapling was no longer in evidence (presumed dead).
inscription: 467 RAAF SQUADRON ASSOCIATION/ This tree was planted in memory of/ the Crew of Lancaster PO-L LM311/ which crashed on return from Turin/ 13th July 1943/ (Names)/ We shall Cherish their Memory
